# Enable Lambda Insights<AvailableFrom v="4.0.61" />

Enable [Lambda Insights in AWS CloudWatch](/docs/lambda/insights). For this to work, you may have to update your role permission.

## CLI flag

```text
--enable-lambda-insights
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion lambda functions deploy`](/docs/lambda/cli/functions/deploy)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`deployFunction()`](/docs/lambda/deployfunction#enablelambdainsights)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setLambdaInsights(true);
```
